releases.title: Polished SPA Templates & Dev Server
releases.description: Redesigned SPA template views with professional layouts matching the QuickStart demo. Added built-in development server (npx domma serve) with live reload and automatic project detection. Fixed template CSS paths.

releases.title: SPA Template Path Fixes
releases.description: Fixed broken CSS and JavaScript paths in SPA template that caused white screen errors after npx domma init.

releases.title: Development Server with npm Scripts
releases.description: Added npm scripts (npm start, npm run serve) to generated projects for easier development workflow. Server auto-prompts after npx domma init.

releases.title: Built-in Development Server
releases.description: Introduced npx domma serve command with optional live-server integration, automatic MPA/SPA detection, and custom port support (default: 3096).

releases.title: DommaJS Brand Refresh & Bug Fixes
releases.description: Rebranded to DommaJS across splash page, navbar, and footer. Improved feature card animations with smooth breathing effect. Fixed critical backToTop bug that could destroy page body element when selector parameter was used.

releases.title: SPA Router & Ambient Effects
releases.description: Hash-based SPA routing with middleware support, view lifecycle hooks, and navigation events. Added CSS-only ambient background effects (rotating glows, floating blobs, waves) for stunning visual presentations without JavaScript.

releases.title: Address MiniApp
releases.description: New production MiniApp for UK address lookup with postcode search. Features ONS local data integration, premium getAddress.io provider support, bar charts for analytics, and star ratings for saved addresses.

releases.title: Schema Builder - Visual Blueprint Designer
releases.description: Build Domma Blueprints visually with drag-and-drop. Features 21 field types, live form preview with validation testing, 12-column grid layout support, and multi-format export to JavaScript, JSON, or TypeScript.

releases.title: Easier Project Setup
releases.description: New CLI tools and setup documentation make getting started faster. Run the post-install script to configure your environment automatically.

releases.title: Blueprints - Define Once, Use Everywhere
releases.description: Major release introducing Blueprints for unified data schemas. Define your data structure once and use it with Models, Forms, and CRUD operations automatically.

releases.title: Build System Updates
releases.description: Updated distribution bundles with improved build process and version consistency across all bundle variants.

releases.title: CDN Distribution Ready
releases.description: Framework now available via CDN for easier integration. Simply include the script tag and start using Domma in your projects.

releases.title: Foundation Release
releases.description: Core framework with DOM manipulation, utilities, reactive models, UI components, and theming system.
